scope: bounded read-only source review only; no implementation, build, test, actor, SSH or target execution
checked: created positive PID becomes owned even if shim reports a post-create local error
8KiB per-pipe drain budget; WNOHANG-only waits; cap failure sticky; no drain can block the caller indefinitely
ECHILD marks ownership permanently lost before signal decisions; reaped/lost PIDs never signaled
TERM once, SIGKILL once after2s while PID remains owned and unreaped
post-reap endpoint removal matches observed dev/inode/uid/mode/link-count; PID file also exact owned PID and rechecked identity; unknown leftovers not deleted
strict complete serializer-v1 success record matches actual rr_format field order, canonical decimals, nonce, owned PID, bounded API address order/duplicates; failed parse preserves caller output
pinned uds_daemon.c writes PID_FILE using decimal PID plus newline, matching pid_contents
integration_requirements: A caller must stop/tick/reap any created child even when dlr_child_start returns -1
The outer finite lifecycle owns whole-run and final-drain deadlines; child_tick alone deliberately does not invent a reaped verdict for an unresponsive child or lingering pipe
child_done is an ownership-completion predicate; acceptance separately needs child.error==0, expected wait status and actual endpoint/probe observations
Endpoint identity assumes the declared exclusive process context and trusted root RAM directory; missing endpoints after reap are cleanup only, not evidence that readiness occurred
DNS membership/global address policy and exact first TCP destination equality with the API first result are separate from the grammar parser
